title: Simplify naive async
description:
I was following [this](https://rstudio.github.io/promises/articles/casestudy.html) case study and tried to apply it to a more complex app. I think it is easier to put the result of the future as soon as possible in a reactive, and not propagate all the way to the render functions. This way you need to change less on the other code of your app, you only need to add `req()` if you do not have it yet. 

Basically point 3:

> Any code that relies on the result of those operations (if any), whether directly or indirectly, now must be converted to promise handlers that operate on the future object.

is not required anymore, neither `promise_all()`. I made an example how this would work for the cranwhales package. Off course for learning purposes it is good to show all the conversions. But I think this example is also useful to show (and results in cleaner code in my opinion :smile: ).

title: Handle NULL input$detail_ip_name
description: Without this fix, the app errors whenever I change the number of whales() shown. I didn't attempt to figure out the root cause, just fixed the symptom.
